Education
Education Overview
Leadership
UNMC Graduate Studies is lead by a diverse group of faculty and staff dedicated to advancing health science education at UNMC.
Awards and Recognition
The Office of Graduate Studies celebrates the accomplishments of graduate students who go above and beyond.
Students of Distinction
The Graduate Students of Distinction award is reserved for students who receive national and international recognition.
Learning Outcomes
Each of the five Graduate Studies Learning Outcomes fulfill one or more of UNMC’s Institutional Learning Outcomes.
Annual Report
View our major accomplishments on our journey of positively impacting the nation’s supply of research scientists, educators and leaders.
Contact Us
Contact the Office of Graduate Studies however is easiest for you. Normal office hours are 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Monday to Friday.
Admissions
Admissions Overview
Steps to Admission
Steps to Admission
Review the process to join UNMC Graduate Studies, from application to enrollment.
Non-Degree Students
We offer flexibility in non-degree courses for students looking to further professional abilities, advance workplace skills, or simply learn something new.
Intercampus Enrollment
Students within the University of Nebraska are able to take courses at other NU campuses to fulfill degree requirements for their home college.
Incoming Students
Incoming Students
Review important steps to complete as you prepare for your first day of classes at UNMC.
Matriculation Ceremony
Build a community of fellow students who will become invaluable friends and teammates as you work toward your advanced degrees.
Incoming Student Survival Guide
This guide was created by UNMC graduate students to aid incoming students and help them achieve success as they acclimate to our campus.
Moving to Omaha
When you’re not hitting the books, the Omaha metro offers plenty of options to comfortably accommodate your lifestyle.
International Students
English Proficiency
UNMC graduate courses are advanced and require a firm understanding of the English language in order to best succeed.
Equivalent Degrees
Review a list of international degrees that are considered equivalent to a four-year Bachelor’s degree in the United States.
Financial Resources
International students who wish to gain an F-1 or J-1 visa must be able to provide evidence of financial support for the first year of study.
Immigration and Visas
We’ll pair you with an International Student Advisor to help you through the process of obtaining a student visa.
Costs and Funding
Costs and Funding
At UNMC, we work to make our tuition affordable year after year. Review opportunities for financing your graduate degree.
Assistantships/Fellowships
Review eligibility criteria and deadlines to apply for a Graduate Studies Research Assistantship or Fellowship at UNMC.
External Funding Opportunities
Many outside corporations, businesses, and agencies provide funding for graduate students. We offer additional incentives for successful applications.
Office of Financial Aid
The Office of Financial Aid manages financial aid distribution, UNMC scholarships and grants, and veteran and military education benefits.
Programs
Programs Overview
Certificate Programs
Business for Bioscientists
The Business for Bioscientists Certificate is designed to provide you with a fundamental background in business to enhance employment opportunities and success.
Health Professions Teaching and Technology
This certificate provides health professions educators with a foundation in health science education, teaching skills, and the science of teaching.
Applied Health Informatics
This certificate prepares healthcare professionals with the skills necessary to effectively apply health informatics in practice to improve patient care.
Heathcare Quality Improvement
Through this certificate, health care professionals will engage in the application and utility of quality improvement to optimize healthcare service delivery.
Master’s Programs
The Medical Sciences Interdepartmental Area Program (MSIA)
The MSIA is intended for those who wish to pursue individually designed programs of an interdisciplinary nature within the medical sciences.
MS Degree Timeline
Review UNMC’s Master’s degree timeline and make sure you stay on track to graduate.
Individual Programs
A Master’s degree from UNMC Graduate Studies can help you gain the additional skills you need to take your health sciences career to the next level
Doctoral Programs
The Medical Sciences Interdepartmental Area Program (MSIA)
The MSIA is intended for those who wish to pursue individually designed programs of an interdisciplinary nature within the medical sciences.
Interdisciplinary Graduate Program in Biomedical Sciences (IGPBS)
This programs consists of seven interdisciplinary doctoral programs with over 200 participating research faculty from 32 basic science and clinical departments.
Individual Programs
As a doctoral student, you will work with faculty members who are global leaders in health science innovation.
PhD Degree Timeline
Review UNMC’s Doctoral degree timeline and make sure you stay on track to graduate.
Institutional Training Grant Programs
Institutional Training Grant Programs for Doctoral Students
UNMC's institutional training grant programs offer enhanced, specialized experience on top of your doctoral program coursework.
Institutional Training Grants Definition
Find out what institutional training grants are and the types available at UNMC for doctoral students.
Benefits of Participating
Discover how working on one of our training grants can advance your career and set you up for success.
Professional Development
Professional Development Overview
Career Planning
Career Counseling
Our counselors can provide you with additional insight, information, and perspectives on career opportunities and professions.
Proficiency and Certificate Programs
These non-degree programs enhance your background and create further career opportunities and possibilities upon graduation.
Individual Development Plan (IDP)
Establishing an Individual Development Plan will give you the tools to reach your professional goals and make sure you stay on track.
On-Line Career Training Platform
Log into Beyond the Professoriate's career training platform to explore career options and prepare for careers inside and outside academia.
Workshops
Dissertation & Thesis Boot Camps
Whether you can't find a good place to begin or are simply procrastinating, UNMC's Dissertation and Thesis Boot Camps are here to help.
Teaching Skills
UNMC Graduate Studies has a variety of opportunities for you to obtain and grow the teaching skills needed to thrive as an educator.
Workshops and Seminars
Our workshops, presentations and seminars bolster you with an extra edge for present and future professional ventures, regardless of the career you choose.
Lunch & Learn
The Professional Development Lunch and Learn Series provides you with various seminar topics to help develop professional skills.
Badge Programs
Service-Learning and Professional Development Badge Program
A program that empowers graduate students to document their learning from time devoted to a wide range of activities, many of which occur outside of the laboratory or classroom, that supplement their education, support professional development, and enhance career preparation.
Transferable Skills Digital Badge Program
Online microcredentials not for academic credit that allow you to showcase your achievements and skills gained through co-curricular learning experiences. Digital badges can be displayed on social media platforms. Time spent earning these digital badges is automatically applied to the Service Learning and Professional Development Badge Program.

PhD Timeline
As a doctoral student, you will work with faculty members who are global leaders in health science innovation. Under their mentorship, you will gain opportunities and experience you need to become a leader in your field.
Students enter Graduate Studies through one of our two umbrella programs or through one of the individual doctoral programs.
Apply Now
Interdisciplinary Graduate Program in Biomedical Sciences
With the Interdisciplinary Graduate Program in Biomedical Sciences (IGPBS) program, you receive a common core curriculum and then advanced interdisciplinary training once you select your area of interest.
IGPBS Program Details
Biochemistry & Molecular Biology
Gain the experience necessary for the development of independent investigators in various areas of biochemistry and molecular biology.
Bioinformatics & Systems Biology
This program addresses questions in biomedical research, from novel algorithm development to the application of bioinformatics tools for knowledge discovery.
Cancer Research
Search for solutions to one of medicine's greatest challenges with an innovative Cancer Research PhD from UNMC.
Immunology, Pathology & Infectious Diseases
The Immunology, Pathology & Infectious Disease PhD program provides a strong background in pathobiology, microbiology and other basic sciences.
Integrative Physiology & Molecular Medicine
Study cellular and molecular processes underscoring coordinated integration of organ systems within the body, typically with a view to unraveling disease mechanisms.
Molecular Genetics & Cell Biology
Make discoveries at the frontiers of molecular genetics and cell biology with a PhD from UNMC.
Neuroscience
In terms of basic sciences, neuroscience is one of the last remaining major frontiers in science.
Medical Sciences Interdepartmental Area
The Medical Sciences Interdepartmental Area (MSIA) is intended for those who wish to pursue individually designed programs of an interdisciplinary nature within the medical sciences. The program offers a Doctoral degree in the following areas:
MSIA Program Details
PhD in Applied Behavior Analysis
The Applied Behavior Analysis PhD program teaches skills that will prepare students for positions in academic, clinical, and research arenas.
PhD in Biological Defense and Health Security
Students will engage with scientific principles in the emerging global security areas related to defense against infectious disease.
PhD in Clinical & Translational Research Mentored Scholars Program
The CTR-MSP program develops scientists or health professionals at the junior faculty stage into independent clinical and translational researchers.
PhD in Clinically Relevant Basic Research
Students in this program will learn processes and methodologies affiliated with basic science studies that have translational relevance to the health of patients.
PhD in Health Practice & Medical Education Research
Students will engage in research that explores health practice, health policy, population health, or health education.
PhD in Oral Biology
Students will engage with clinically important problems concerned with the biological, chemical and physical basis of issues related to oral health.
PhD in Patient-Oriented Research
Students will engage in and learn the processes of patient-oriented clinical research.
Individual Doctoral Programs
PhD in Biomedical Informatics
Biomedical Informatics combines IT management, computer science, and applied computing with clinical science, biological science, bio-imaging, and public health.
PhD in Biostatistics
The PhD in Biostatistics develops biomedical informaticians who will advance research and practice in contemporary information and knowledge management.
PhD in Environmental Health, Occupational Health & Toxicology
Develop abilities to address scientific problems in the fields of environmental health, ecological health, occupational health and safety, and toxicology.
PhD in Epidemiology
Design, conduct, and analyze epidemiologic research studies and apply findings to solve public health problems or discover causes of diseases.
PhD in Health Promotion & Disease Prevention Research
Analyze and intervene in pressing public health issues.
PhD in Health Services and Policy Research
The program focuses on methods and application of health services research, health administration, and health policy.
PhD in Nursing
The PhD in Nursing is a research-focused doctorate that prepares scholars for leadership roles in academia and outside of academia.
PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences
Make impactful scientific discoveries and develop your research skills as a member of UNMC's pharmaceutical sciences doctoral program.
